causality.anchor: UTC epoch multiples of 10 seconds using the latest quote timestamp <= anchor with maximum age 2 seconds.
causality.current_mid: (bid_t + ask_t) / 2 at the eligible anchor quote.
causality.future_mid: latest eligible quote timestamp <= anchor+60s, strictly after anchor, age relative to horizon <=2s; never search after the horizon.
causality.trailing_window: (anchor-15s, anchor] for recent volatility, activity and impulse.
causality.spread_baseline: median spread of the preceding six eligible 10-second anchors, excluding current anchor.
causality.missingness: No interpolation, synthesis or forward fill across gaps; an unavailable feature or outcome makes only that estimand row ineligible.

exposure.contrast: WIDE=Phase22A frozen pair-specific discovery Q5; TIGHT=Phase22A frozen pair-specific discovery Q1; Q2-Q4 excluded from the primary contrast.
exposure.boundaries: Reuse exact Phase 22A 2019-2021 pair-specific boundaries; never refit or optimize.
exposure.effect_orientation: WIDE minus TIGHT. Negative movement effect means lower subsequent absolute movement in WIDE state.

controls.fit_rule: All numeric boundaries use pair-specific empirical quintiles estimated on 2019-2021 only and frozen for 2022/2023; no threshold search.
controls.recent_micro_volatility: sum absolute nonzero mid changes over (t-15s,t], in pips; retain continuous log1p value and frozen quintile.
controls.quote_activity: quote count over (t-15s,t] divided by one quarter of quote count over nonoverlapping (t-75s,t-15s]; retain continuous log1p ratio and frozen quintile; denominator zero is missing.
controls.time_of_day: fixed UTC hour categorical 0-23; weekday categorical Monday-Friday; no data-derived session boundaries.
controls.recent_directional_impulse: mid_t minus causal as-of mid at t-15s, in raw pips; encode sign {-1,0,+1} and frozen quintile of absolute magnitude.
controls.pair: fixed categorical EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, USDCAD; pooled estimates weight pair-days equally.

broader_liquidity_state.baseline_micro_volatility: sum absolute mid changes in (t-75s,t-15s] in pips

inference.primary_unit: UTC trading-day block; pair-day estimates are observations for named pooled contrasts, while frozen WLS operates on eligible anchor rows with pair-day weights.

estimator_contract.estimator: weighted least squares (WLS) using the frozen row weights
estimator_contract.arithmetic: IEEE-754 binary64 only; inputs and ordered design matrix must contain finite values
estimator_contract.transformed_system: Xw = sqrt(w) columnwise-multiplied into X rows; yw = sqrt(w)*y; zero or negative weights invalidate the run
estimator_contract.solver: LAPACK DGELSD singular-value least squares through an implementation pinned in the implementation manifest
estimator_contract.rank_rule: rank is count(singular_value > rcond * largest_singular_value); rank must equal K
estimator_contract.coefficient_order: exact model coefficient_names order; extraction by exact name only
estimator_contract.residual: unweighted residual e_i = y_i - x_i beta; weighted estimating score uses w_i*x_i*e_i
estimator_contract.failure: Any non-finite input/output, rank failure, condition failure, solver warning/error, or coefficient-name mismatch yields PHASE_22B_INVALID_RESEARCH_RUN before scientific classification.

covariance_and_wald_contract.estimator: UTC-day clustered CR1 sandwich covariance for coefficient/Wald diagnostics
covariance_and_wald_contract.cluster: UTC calendar date; all pairs for a date are one cluster
covariance_and_wald_contract.bread: inverse(X transpose W X), computed from the accepted DGELSD SVD as V*diag(1/s^2)*V transpose; no pseudoinverse of a rank-deficient matrix
covariance_and_wald_contract.cluster_score: u_g = sum over rows i in UTC day g of w_i*x_i*e_i
covariance_and_wald_contract.correction: G/(G-1) * (N-1)/(N-K), where G=distinct UTC days, N=eligible rows, K=columns
covariance_and_wald_contract.requirements: G>1, N>K, finite symmetric covariance, and every tested restriction covariance positive definite under the same rcond=1e-12 rank rule
covariance_and_wald_contract.wald: For ordered restriction coefficient vector b and matching covariance V, W=b transpose inverse(V) b; df=length(b); p=upper-tail chi-square(df), evaluated by scipy.stats.chi2.sf in the pinned environment.
covariance_and_wald_contract.failure: Any unmet requirement or inversion/rank/non-finite failure yields PHASE_22B_INVALID_RESEARCH_RUN.

bootstrap_contract.unit: UTC calendar day; all eligible rows for every pair on a sampled day travel together
bootstrap_contract.stratification: Within each calendar year present in the stage, independently sample with replacement exactly D_y draws from the ASCII-sorted list of D_y distinct eligible UTC dates.
bootstrap_contract.rng: NumPy Generator(PCG64(seed)); process years ascending; draw integer indices with Generator.integers(0,D_y,size=D_y,endpoint=False); iteration order 0..9999.
bootstrap_contract.duplicated_days: Each repeated draw receives a deterministic copy index and contributes a full copied day block. Pair-day row weights are recomputed inside each copy so each eligible copied pair-day totals one.
bootstrap_contract.stage_fit: Concatenate copied blocks in year-ascending, draw-position, timestamp, pair-ASCII order; rebuild the exact frozen matrix; refit the same WLS estimator. No bootstrap resample may change boundaries, eligibility rules, columns, or models.
bootstrap_contract.estimand_aggregation: For model coefficients, use the single refitted stage coefficient. For named contrasts, first compute each copied pair-day contrast, average equally over copied pair-days within year, then average constituent calendar-year estimates equally in ascending year order.
bootstrap_contract.invalid_resample: Any resample fit or required statistic failure invalidates the entire research run; do not skip, redraw, replace, or reduce B.
bootstrap_contract.confidence_interval: Percentile CI from all 10000 finite bootstrap statistics using numpy.quantile method=linear at q=0.025 and 0.975; sorted binary64 values; no BCa/studentization.
bootstrap_contract.h_raw_p_value: For negative alternative, p=(1 + count(theta_b >= 0))/(10000+1). Exact zeros and signed zeros count in the null-side numerator; NaN/infinite values invalidate the run. No doubled/two-sided value controls H_RAW.
bootstrap_contract.two_sided_diagnostic: p=minimum(1, 2*minimum((1+count(theta_b<=0))/(B+1),(1+count(theta_b>=0))/(B+1))); zeros count in both tails; diagnostic only.
bootstrap_contract.reproducibility: Repeat from identical ordered inputs and seed; coefficients, statistics, p-values, quantiles, and canonical serialized bootstrap summary must be byte-identical or the run is invalid.

permutation_diagnostic.role: diagnostic only; never changes advancement or classification
permutation_diagnostic.mechanism: Within each pair-day, permute WIDE/TIGHT labels independently inside the Cartesian strata UTC-hour x volatility-quintile x activity-quintile.
permutation_diagnostic.ordering: Pair-days sorted date then pair ASCII; strata sorted hour 00..23, vol Q1..Q5, activity Q1..Q5; rows sorted timestamp then source sequence.
permutation_diagnostic.rng: NumPy Generator(PCG64(22003)); 10000 iterations; Fisher-Yates behavior of Generator.permutation on ordered label arrays.
permutation_diagnostic.invalidity: Missing required stratum metadata, nondeterministic ordering, or non-finite required output yields PHASE_22B_INVALID_RESEARCH_RUN.

multiple_testing.algorithm: Within each family and stage, sort by (raw_p ascending,hypothesis_id ASCII ascending). Missing/non-finite tests invalidate the run. For m tests, adjusted p at sorted rank i is min(1, minimum over j>=i of m*p_j/j). Reject the largest rank k with p_k <= q*k/m and all ranks <=k. Ties retain hypothesis-ID order. No pooling across stages. H_RAW is sole primary and unadjusted.
multiple_testing.h_mixed: REMOVED; MIXED_MECHANISM is a deterministic classification over named corrected tests and attenuation gates, not a hypothesis.

inference.missing_cell_rule: Do not impute. A scientific contrast cell requires at least 20 eligible anchors per exposure group and a pair-day requires both groups. Failure of a scientific sample-size/cell requirement, after all operational checks pass, yields PHENOMENON_NOT_CONFIRMED; malformed/missing provenance or inability to calculate eligibility yields PHASE_22B_INVALID_RESEARCH_RUN.
inference.software_determinism: Pin Python, NumPy, SciPy, BLAS/LAPACK vendor and versions in the implementation manifest; force single-thread linear algebra; stable timestamp and ASCII categorical sorting; canonical JSON and SHA-256 for every stage.

effect_size_and_stability.raw_pip_minimum: A genuine effect requires pooled adjusted WIDE-minus-TIGHT <= -0.05 pips at 60 seconds and a 95% CI wholly below zero in each advancement stage.
effect_size_and_stability.retention_after_adjustment: M4 magnitude must be at least 50% of M0 and retain the negative sign.
effect_size_and_stability.pair_stability: Negative adjusted sign in at least 3 of 4 pairs; no one pair may exceed 50% of summed absolute pair effects.
effect_size_and_stability.development_year_stability: Negative adjusted sign separately in 2019, 2020 and 2021.
effect_size_and_stability.temporal_replication: Unchanged negative adjusted sign, <=-0.05 pips and CI below zero in 2022 and separately in 2023.
effect_size_and_stability.session_stability: Report every fixed session. Genuine classification requires negative sign in at least three of asian, london_pre_overlap, overlap and new_york_post_overlap; off_session is descriptive.
effect_size_and_stability.concentration: Top five UTC days <50% of total absolute daily effect and largest month <50% of summed absolute month effects.
effect_size_and_stability.threshold_provenance: Every numeric effect, attenuation, concentration, cell-size, and replication threshold in this section was selected after aggregate Phase 22A evidence was observed. These are post-observation Phase 22B decision thresholds, not preregistered Phase 22A thresholds; claims are limited to retrospective internal replication.

confounding_rules.material_attenuation: A control block materially confounds when its addition causes >=50% attenuation versus the immediately preceding model, or reverses sign, and the adjusted CI includes zero or violates the -0.05 pip minimum in both 2022 and 2023.
confounding_rules.partial_attenuation: 25% to <50% attenuation with retained sign is evidence for a mixed mechanism, not full explanation.
confounding_rules.interaction_evidence: An interaction family matters only if BH-FDR survives and the exposure effect fails the frozen stability requirement in at least one prespecified stratum in both 2022 and 2023.
confounding_rules.pair_specific: Fewer than 3 pairs retain negative adjusted sign, or one pair contributes >=50% of summed absolute pair effects, consistently in 2022 and 2023.
confounding_rules.threshold_provenance: All attenuation and contribution cutoffs are post-observation Phase 22B decision thresholds and do not support pristine-confirmation claims.

terminal_classification_algorithm.rule: Any operational_validation trigger is true; evaluated first.

H_RAW passes all frozen raw-pip effect, adjustment, temporal replication, pair, session and concentration gates; no full confounder rule passes. This is not independent future confirmation and is non-actionable.
Current-spread-unit effect replicates but frozen raw and denominator-independent requirements fail and amplification ratio >=4 in both temporal replications.
M2 material attenuation and corresponding omnibus interaction FDR decision replicate in 2022 and 2023.
Frozen session sensitivity or M4 liquidity block meets its confounding criterion with replicating corrected omnibus evidence.
Frozen pair-specific criterion holds in both temporal replications.
At least two named blocks each meet partial attenuation or corrected replicating interaction criteria while raw effect remains; no standalone prior class applies.
No prior scientific class applies or scientific evidence is insufficient without an operational-invalid trigger.

advancement_and_rejection.advance_to_2022: 2019-2021 implementation passes leakage and QA; H_RAW and all diagnostics defined by this exact frozen specification are complete and artifact-frozen. Mechanism candidates are not selected or changed; every test defined by this exact frozen specification advances unchanged.
advancement_and_rejection.advance_to_2023: 2022 artifact is complete, hash-frozen and independently validated; no definitions, models, thresholds, directions or classifications changed.
advancement_and_rejection.phase22b_success: Only GENUINE_SPREAD_STATE_PHENOMENON may be called a confirmed genuine mechanism candidate. Other classifications are informative closures and do not authorize strategy work.
advancement_and_rejection.reject_genuine_claim: Any raw-pip minimum, CI, temporal, pair, session, concentration or adjustment-retention criterion fails.
advancement_and_rejection.insufficient_evidence: After and only after all operational checks pass: insufficient eligible scientific sample/cells or failure of a scientific effect/stability criterion yields PHENOMENON_NOT_CONFIRMED. Any integrity, leakage, authorization, provenance, determinism, estimator, bootstrap, or reproducibility failure yields exclusively PHASE_22B_INVALID_RESEARCH_RUN.

hypothesis_inventory.advancement_gate_separation: Statistical rejection of H_RAW does not itself establish classification; post-observation effect/stability/confounding gates apply separately.

hypothesis_inventory.statistic: R=abs(delta_current_spread_units)/abs(delta_fixed_scale), using stage-level M0 pair-day weighted contrasts
hypothesis_inventory.raw_p_value: One-sided upper bootstrap p=(1+count(R_b < 4))/10001 over exactly 10000 finite bootstrap replicates; R_b exactly 4 is not counted in the null-side numerator; zero fixed-scale denominator or any non-finite R_b yields PHASE_22B_INVALID_RESEARCH_RUN.

Raw-pip, trailing-spread-unit, fixed-scale, effect-size, and stability gate failures are not part of this null or alternative; they are evaluated only by terminal_classification_algorithm.NORMALIZATION_ARTIFACT after all operational checks pass.

specification_binding.rule: Every authorization and independent-review manifest must bind the externally reproduced canonical SHA-256 of this exact frozen specification. The artifact does not self-declare its canonical hash.

implementation_determinism_v7.precedence: These deterministic clarifications supersede ambiguous prose in v6 only where explicitly named; all unmentioned v6 scientific definitions remain unchanged.

fixed_discovery_scale.estimation: For each pair, compute the median of finite positive current_spread_pips across every eligible 2019-2021 anchor before WIDE/TIGHT filtering, using numpy.median binary64. Compute once after causal eligibility and before outcome/model missingness filters.
fixed_discovery_scale.freeze: Write the four values and the ordered anchor-input root hashes to the development artifact before fitting any model. Reuse byte-identically for every 2019-2021 diagnostic and any later separately unlocked stage. A missing/nonpositive/nonfinite value invalidates the run.

source_partition_contract.duplicates: Preserve all duplicate timestamps in source_row_ordinal order; latest as-of quote is the last row under that total order.
source_partition_contract.ordering: Stable sort by timestamp_utc_ns then source_row_ordinal, where source_row_ordinal is the zero-based physical row order within the hash-verified file.
source_partition_contract.context: Only explicitly task-listed adjacent 2019-2021 units of the same pair may provide causal lookback/horizon context; output anchors are clipped to the requested pair-year unit. No directory discovery.
source_partition_contract.partition_identity: Task-authorized pair-year is external metadata and every timestamp must lie in [year-01-01T00:00:00Z,(year+1)-01-01T00:00:00Z).
source_partition_contract.validity: Reject null/nonfinite timestamps, bid, ask; require bid>0, ask>0, ask>=bid and nondecreasing total order after stable sort.

complete_case_and_cells.policy: Eligibility is computed per named response/model. Exclude only a row missing a variable used by that exact response/model and record one count per ordered first-failure reason.
complete_case_and_cells.cell_rule: For each required contrast cell, require at least 20 eligible anchors in both WIDE and TIGHT after exact-model complete-case filtering. Otherwise that scientific contrast is INSUFFICIENT, never an operational invalidity, unless a required primary stage has no evaluable contrast at all.

attenuation_bootstrap.material: A step is materially attenuating when point attenuation>=0.50 or beta_WIDE changes sign, AND the adjusted model B raw-pip 95% CI includes zero or its upper and lower bounds do not both remain <=-0.05. For later replication language this same named step must satisfy the predicate separately in both 2022 and 2023.
attenuation_bootstrap.ci: Two-sided 95% percentile CI from exactly 10000 paired daily-block replicates, numpy.quantile method=linear.
attenuation_bootstrap.statistic: For each bootstrap resample and step A_to_B, compute attenuation=1-(beta_WIDE_B/beta_WIDE_A). If beta_WIDE_A equals zero or either coefficient is nonfinite, invalidate the run.

normalization_artifact_predicates.denominator_independent_requirements: In a stage, both M4 Y_RAW_ABS_60S_PIPS and M4 Y_FIXED_DISCOVERY_SCALE must have beta_WIDE<=-0.05 in their own response units after converting fixed scale back to pips, with two-sided 95% CIs wholly below zero; Y_TRAILING_SPREAD_UNITS must be negative with CI wholly below zero.
normalization_artifact_predicates.current_spread_effect_replicates: The stage-level M0 WIDE-minus-TIGHT Y_CURRENT_SPREAD_UNITS point contrast is negative in 2022 and separately negative in 2023. This sign predicate defines effect replication; it adds no CI, H_NORM significance, or FDR requirement.
normalization_artifact_predicates.fail_definition: NORMALIZATION_ARTIFACT requires: the current-spread effect-replication sign predicate; amplification ratio R>=4 in 2022 and separately in 2023; and the frozen raw and denominator-independent requirements fail in both stages. H_NORM p-values/FDR remain reported evidence but are not an added terminal-classification requirement.

interaction_strata.stability_failure: A stratum fails when fewer than 20 exact-model complete-case anchors exist in either exposure group, or the adjusted contrast is nonnegative, or its CI includes zero, or the raw-pip contrast is greater than -0.05 pips. The same named stratum must fail in both 2022 and 2023 for replicating interaction evidence.
interaction_strata.aggregation: Evaluate every listed level separately; do not pool or select levels. Pair interaction levels are pair-specific; hour/session/quintile/sign levels use their frozen categorical definitions.
interaction_strata.uncertainty: Compute paired daily-block bootstrap two-sided 95% percentile CI for each level contrast using exactly 10000 replicates.
interaction_strata.estimand: Within each prespecified level named by an interaction test, use the fitted interaction model linear contrast beta_WIDE plus the exact corresponding WIDE-by-level coefficient; the reference level uses beta_WIDE.

permutation_diagnostic.procedure: Within each pair x UTC-day, independently within every Cartesian stratum UTC-hour x volatility-quintile x activity-quintile, permute only the ordered WIDE/TIGHT labels using NumPy Generator(PCG64(22003)); preserve all outcomes, controls, rows and stratum sizes; process pair-days date then pair ASCII, strata hour 00..23 then vol Q1..Q5 then activity Q1..Q5, rows timestamp then source sequence; refit M4 for each of exactly 10000 permutations.
permutation_diagnostic.statistic: Absolute value of the observed M4 raw-pip exposure__WIDE coefficient.
permutation_diagnostic.role: Diagnostic only; never changes advancement or terminal classification.

determinism.environment: Set OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1, MKL_NUM_THREADS=1, NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 before importing NumPy/SciPy; record Python, NumPy, pandas, SciPy, BLAS/LAPACK versions.
determinism.replay: Run analysis twice from identical ordered hash-verified inputs; canonical result bytes excluding run timestamps must be byte-identical.

implementation_determinism_v8.precedence: These four deterministic clarifications supersede v7 only for the four implementation ambiguities explicitly named here; implementation_determinism_v7 and every unmentioned v6/v7 scientific definition remain unchanged.

empirical_quintile_ties.estimation: Use numpy.quantile(binary64_values, [0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8], method="linear") on the frozen eligible estimation population in its frozen scope. Finite cutpoints need only be nondecreasing; repeated cutpoints are valid and MUST NOT invalidate, jitter, rank-randomize, or refit the run.
empirical_quintile_ties.assignment: Assign each finite value with numpy.searchsorted(the four stored cutpoints, value, side="right") + 1, yielding integer Q1..Q5. A value equal to one or more tied cutpoints passes all equal cutpoints and enters the bin immediately above the last equal cutpoint. Empty intermediate bins caused by ties are retained as empty prespecified levels and are handled only by the existing minimum-cell/estimability rules.
empirical_quintile_ties.provenance: Store cutpoints as four ordered binary64-derived JSON numbers, including repeats, and reuse them unchanged. Nonfinite estimation or assignment values follow the existing model-specific missingness rules.

zero_current_spread.source_validity: A finite quote with ask equal to bid is source-valid under the unchanged ask>=bid rule. Its current_spread_pips is exactly +0.0 and the row is not globally removed or declared operationally invalid.
zero_current_spread.exposure: When trailing_median_spread_pips is finite and strictly positive, spread_dislocation for a zero current spread is exactly 0.0 and empirical-quintile assignment proceeds normally; it enters the frozen bin determined by the right-sided rule. A nonpositive trailing median fails spread_baseline under the existing first-failure order.
zero_current_spread.response_specific: Y_RAW_ABS_60S_PIPS, Y_TRAILING_SPREAD_UNITS, and Y_FIXED_DISCOVERY_SCALE remain eligible if their own required values are finite. Y_CURRENT_SPREAD_UNITS is undefined when current_spread_pips equals zero and that row is excluded only for that named response/model at the existing response first-failure reason. Zero spreads are excluded from fixed_discovery_scale median estimation by the already frozen finite-positive rule.

streaming_context_equivalence.reference: The authoritative computation is the stable full concatenation of all explicitly task-listed adjacent authorized units for one pair, ordered by timestamp_utc_ns, then authorized unit order, then source_row_ordinal. Output anchors are clipped to the requested unit bounds after features/outcomes are computed.
streaming_context_equivalence.chunk_state: A streaming implementation MUST produce canonical row-for-row and value-for-value equality to the reference computation. Across chunk/unit boundaries it must carry: the last quote needed for each as-of lookup; all ordered ticks in the open-left/closed-right 75-second causal history window; the quote needed at anchor-minus-15-seconds; the six preceding eligible anchor current-spread values and their eligibility/order for the shifted trailing median; and enough ordered future input through anchor-plus-60-seconds to apply the frozen as-of and two-second freshness rule. Duplicate timestamps retain authorized unit order then source_row_ordinal.
streaming_context_equivalence.boundaries: No synthetic padding, interpolation, reset at calendar/month/year/chunk boundaries, or directory discovery is permitted. Context may come only from explicitly task-listed adjacent 2019-2021 units of the same pair. If required adjacent context is not authorized or available, affected boundary anchors receive the existing ordered freshness/baseline missingness reason; they are never repaired.
streaming_context_equivalence.verification: Before research execution, a multi-chunk synthetic fixture spanning duplicate timestamps and month/year boundaries must match the full-concatenation reference in anchor identities, values, missingness reasons, exposure/stratum labels, and canonical bytes.

scalable_exact_resampling_representation.logical_sample: The frozen bootstrap/permutation sample remains the exact logical expanded row sample generated by the v7 PCG64 seeds, ordered day/stratum draws, label permutations, and estimand. Optimization may change only its in-memory representation.
scalable_exact_resampling_representation.multiplicity: Repeated identical UTC-day blocks may be represented by deterministic nonnegative integer multiplicities. For coefficient fitting, multiply each retained row WLS weight by its block multiplicity and pass the square-root-weighted matrix and response to the same numpy.linalg.lstsq DGELSD path and rcond. For CR1, n is the logical expanded row count, G is the logical count of drawn day-block copies, and meat adds multiplicity times the outer product of the one-copy cluster score; a repeated block MUST NOT be treated as one cluster with a multiplicity-scaled score. Permutation strata/labels may be cached but the exact v7 Generator calls and consumption order MUST occur.
scalable_exact_resampling_representation.caching: Deterministic cached design matrices, response vectors, index arrays, and sufficient cross-products are allowed only when they are pure functions of frozen ordered rows and reproduce the logical sample. Caching may not drop rows, alter weights, merge nonidentical blocks, replace DGELSD, change covariance, skip random draws, or change refit count.
scalable_exact_resampling_representation.equivalence: Before production use, synthetic fixtures including repeated day draws, duplicate timestamps, rank-edge designs, and all interaction restrictions must compare optimized and explicitly expanded references. Integer draw/label schedules and logical n/G must be exact; coefficients, covariance entries, Wald statistics, bootstrap/permutation statistics, and p-values must be either bit-identical or within 8 binary64 ULPs with identical finite/rank/condition outcomes. Every threshold, sign, rejection, material-attenuation, minimum-cell, and terminal decision must be identical; a value within the numeric tolerance of any decision boundary fails closed instead of choosing a side.
scalable_exact_resampling_representation.hashes: Record SHA-256 of the little-endian int64 resampling draw/label schedule, representation-version identifier, ordered input roots, and little-endian float64 replicate vector. Deterministic replay uses the same representation and environment and requires these hashes plus canonical result bytes excluding timestamps to be byte-identical. The explicit-expanded equivalence fixture hashes are separately recorded; equivalence tolerance never relaxes replay identity.

methodology_amendment_v9.precedence: This human-authorized methodology amendment supersedes only implementation_determinism_v7.permutation_diagnostic and permutation-specific clauses of implementation_determinism_v8.scalable_exact_resampling_representation. Bootstrap clauses remain unchanged. No primary hypothesis, estimand, model, gate, threshold, FDR family, terminal classification, partition, direction, pair, horizon, lookback, authority, or safety control changes.
methodology_amendment_v9.selection_timing: Frozen before any Phase 22B market-data execution or outcome inspection; selected for mathematical relevance and feasibility, never observed favorability.

infeasibility_record.old_diagnostic: Exactly 10000 stratified WIDE/TIGHT label permutations with a full M4 refit for each permutation.
infeasibility_record.reason: At approximately 15 million eligible anchors, M4 controls vary inside the permutation strata, so no exact sufficient-statistic compression can reproduce every permuted cross-product without processing the selected row controls. Ten thousand full refits are computationally infeasible.
infeasibility_record.no_exact_compressed_equivalent: Stratum label counts alone are insufficient because continuous volatility, activity, impulse, quote-age, baseline-rate, and liquidity controls vary within strata and their cross-products with permuted exposure change per draw.

cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.null_hypothesis: In the frozen M4 raw-pip model, beta_exposure__WIDE = 0 conditional on every frozen M4 nuisance regressor.
cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.alternative_hypothesis: In the frozen M4 raw-pip model, beta_exposure__WIDE != 0 conditional on every frozen M4 nuisance regressor.
cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.sidedness: Two-sided through a one-degree-of-freedom chi-square statistic; no directional conversion or one-sided interpretation.
cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.tested_parameter: The single frozen M4 coefficient exposure__WIDE.
cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.analysis_rows: Use exactly the frozen M4 Y_RAW_ABS_60S_PIPS exact-model complete-case rows, minimum-cell checks, pair-day weights, and deterministic row order. No score-specific exclusions, imputation, winsorization, subsampling, or thresholding.
cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.unrestricted_relationship: The unrestricted design is the exact frozen M4 design X=[C,z], with z the binary exposure__WIDE column and C every other M4 column in frozen coefficient order. The diagnostic does not fit or replace the reported unrestricted primary M4 result.
cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.restricted_model: Fit y=C*gamma under beta_exposure__WIDE=0 by the frozen pair-day WLS weights using numpy.linalg.lstsq with the frozen rcond after multiplying rows by sqrt(weight). Require full column rank for C and the same frozen condition-number ceiling.
cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.score_vector: Let e=y-C*gamma_hat. Let a solve the weighted auxiliary regression z=C*a+r using the same weighted DGELSD/rcond/rank/condition rules. The scalar efficient score is U=sum_i weight_i*r_i*e_i, evaluated in deterministic row order with numpy.sum float64.
cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.information: Observed efficient information I=sum_i weight_i*r_i^2. Require finite I>0. I is reported but the robust statistic uses the independently clustered score variance below.
cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.cluster_unit: UTC calendar day, identical to frozen primary inference. All pairs within a UTC day form one cluster.
cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.cluster_scores: For each ordered UTC day g, U_g=sum_{i in g} weight_i*r_i*e_i. Compute each sum in frozen row order using numpy.sum float64.
cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.cluster_robust_variance: V_CR1 = [G/(G-1)]*[(N-1)/(N-K)]*sum_g(U_g^2), where N is the exact M4 complete-case row count, G is the number of distinct UTC-day clusters, and K is the full unrestricted M4 column count including exposure__WIDE. Do not center cluster scores and do not merge days.
cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.finite_sample_correction: Exactly G/(G-1) times (N-1)/(N-K), reusing the frozen CR1 convention with unrestricted K. Require G>1 and N>K.
cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.test_statistic: Q=U^2/V_CR1. Report U, I, V_CR1, Q, N, G, K, restricted rank/condition, auxiliary rank/condition.
cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.reference_distribution: Chi-square with exactly 1 degree of freedom.
cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.p_value: p=scipy.stats.chi2.sf(Q,1), binary64. Require finite Q>=0 and finite p in [0,1].
cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.zero_and_tie_handling: If U is exactly +0.0 or -0.0 and V_CR1 is valid positive, Q=0 and p=1.0. No permutation ties exist. Signed zero is canonicalized to +0.0 in output.
cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.missing_data: No additional missing-data rule: use only the exact frozen M4 complete-case population and its already-recorded ordered attrition.
cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.singular_and_failure: PHASE_22B_INVALID_RESEARCH_RUN for nonfinite inputs/results; N<=K; G<=1; rank deficiency; condition ceiling breach; nonfinite or nonpositive I; nonfinite or nonpositive V_CR1; unavailable scipy chi2.sf; coefficient-order mismatch; or deterministic replay/hash mismatch.
cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.numerical_tolerances: Use the frozen RCOND and condition ceiling for both restricted and auxiliary DGELSD fits. V_CR1 and I must be strictly greater than 0. No epsilon replacement, clipping, pseudoinverse, ridge, or fallback distribution.
cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.deterministic_ordering: Stable sort M4 complete cases by UTC day ASCII ascending, anchor_utc_ns ascending, pair ASCII ascending, then source_row_ordinal ascending. Frozen M4 C columns retain their existing order after removing only exposure__WIDE. UTC days are accumulated in sorted order.
cluster_robust_score_diagnostic.deterministic_provenance: Record ordered M4 row-root SHA-256, restricted C/y/weight little-endian float64 root hashes, z uint8 hash, cluster-label hash, diagnostic implementation version, environment, and canonical diagnostic-result hash. Deterministic replay must reproduce every hash and canonical result byte-identically.
non_gating_guarantees: not a member of any FDR family
cannot override H_RAW or M0-M4 evidence
cannot independently establish or reject a scientific classification

implementation_determinism_v10.precedence: Supersedes only bootstrap-specific solver and representation clauses in implementation_determinism_v8.scalable_exact_resampling_representation. The v7 bootstrap population, exact year-stratified UTC-day draw algorithm, PCG64 seed 22002, 10000 replicates, statistics, percentile method, p-value rules, covariance, thresholds, and decisions are unchanged. Point estimates and non-bootstrap primary fits retain the frozen DGELSD implementation.
implementation_determinism_v10.selection_timing: Frozen without opening Phase 22B market data or viewing outcomes.

daily_block_sufficient_statistics.ordered_population: For each exact response/model complete-case population, stable sort by year, UTC-day, anchor_utc_ns, pair ASCII, source_row_ordinal. Build the frozen design X, response y, and pair-day WLS weights once.
daily_block_sufficient_statistics.block_definition: One block is one UTC calendar day across all pairs, identical to the frozen bootstrap and CR1 cluster. Process years ascending and days ISO-ASCII ascending.
daily_block_sufficient_statistics.stored_values: For every day g store binary64 A_g=X_g^T W_g X_g, b_g=X_g^T W_g y_g, n_g=row count, and the ordered block-input SHA-256. Compute matrix products using NumPy float64 in frozen row and column order; symmetrize A_g as (A_g+A_g^T)/2.
daily_block_sufficient_statistics.draw_schedule: Generate the exact unchanged v7 year-stratified day draws with NumPy Generator(PCG64(22002)). For each replicate and year draw exactly D_y indices with replacement using rng.integers(0,D_y,size=D_y,endpoint=False), years ascending. Store integer multiplicity m_bg for each source day. Random calls and consumption order are byte-identical to the expanded reference.

compressed_replicate_fit.normal_system: For replicate b compute A_b=sum_g m_bg*A_g and b_b=sum_g m_bg*b_g in source-day order using binary64 pairwise NumPy reduction. Symmetrize A_b. This is the exact weighted least-squares normal system of the logical expanded sample.
compressed_replicate_fit.rank_and_condition: Compute eigenvalues of A_b with numpy.linalg.eigvalsh in ascending order. Require finite strictly positive lambda_max. Numerical rank is count(lambda_i > RCOND^2*lambda_max), using the frozen RCOND. Require rank K. The logical weighted-design condition number is sqrt(lambda_max/lambda_min) and must not exceed the frozen condition ceiling.
compressed_replicate_fit.solver: Solve A_b*beta_b=b_b using scipy.linalg.solve(A_b,b_b,assume_a="pos",lower=False,check_finite=True,overwrite_a=False,overwrite_b=False). No pseudoinverse, ridge, clipping, iterative solver, fallback, or outcome-dependent choice. Require finite beta and residual normal-equation error ||A_b beta-b_b||_inf <= 64*eps*(||A_b||_inf*||beta||_inf+||b_b||_inf).
compressed_replicate_fit.logical_counts: N_b=sum_g m_bg*n_g. G_b=sum_y D_y is the logical number of drawn day-copy clusters, including repetitions as distinct copies. Require N_b>K and G_b>1.
compressed_replicate_fit.cluster_covariance: For each source day compute one-copy cluster score s_bg=b_g-A_g*beta_b. Meat_b=sum_g m_bg*(s_bg s_bg^T), not outer(m_bg*s,m_bg*s). Bread_b=A_b^{-1} from scipy.linalg.solve against the KxK identity with the same positive-definite contract. Cov_b=[G_b/(G_b-1)]*[(N_b-1)/(N_b-K)]*Bread_b*Meat_b*Bread_b. Symmetrize once and require finite output.
compressed_replicate_fit.statistics: Extract coefficients, covariance-derived Wald quantities, attenuation, linear contrasts, and all bootstrap statistics exactly as frozen. A single model/response bootstrap fit supplies every prespecified linear contrast for that fit; it is not refit separately by level.

non_regression_bootstrap.pair_day_contrasts: For M0 pair-day contrast and normalization-ratio replicates, precompute per-day/pair/exposure finite sums and counts for each named response. Aggregate each logical replicate with unchanged day multiplicities, then calculate the frozen pair-day and year-weighted contrasts. No model solver is invoked.
non_regression_bootstrap.missingness: Each statistic uses its exact frozen paired/common complete-case population before block summaries are built. No union-of-model complete-case filter is permitted.

equivalence_contract.reference: An explicit logical expanded-row implementation using the frozen DGELSD fit and copied UTC-day cluster identifiers remains the synthetic reference only.
equivalence_contract.fixtures: Before market-data access, compare compressed and expanded implementations on fixed-seed fixtures covering all primary/sensitivity/interaction matrices, nested attenuation pairs, repeated days, zero multiplicities, duplicate timestamps, near-rank designs, all named responses, and every prespecified linear contrast.
equivalence_contract.numeric_acceptance: Draw indices, multiplicities, N, G, ranks, condition pass/fail, finite/failure state, signs, threshold/FDR/cell/terminal decisions must be identical. Coefficients, covariance, Wald/contrast/attenuation statistics, and replicate values must be bit-identical or within 32 binary64 ULPs. A discrepancy or either result within 32 ULPs of a scientific decision boundary invalidates the run; no side is selected.
equivalence_contract.distribution_acceptance: On a fixed 10000-replicate fixture, percentile endpoints and p-value numerators must be identical; canonical rounded reporting values must match. The compressed replicate-vector SHA-256 must reproduce byte-identically across two runs in the frozen environment.

performance_acceptance.benchmark: Before market-data access, execute 10000 compressed replicates with 1096 synthetic day blocks and K=80, including beta and CR1 covariance, under frozen single-thread environment.
performance_acceptance.limit: Wall time <=30 minutes and peak additional resident memory <=4 GiB on the repository-managed host. Extrapolated wall time for every frozen Phase 22B bootstrap fit must be <=12 hours, calculated from measured B*D*K^2 + B*K^3 work and the exact frozen model list. Failure blocks data access.
performance_acceptance.streaming: Process replicates in deterministic fixed chunks of 128 only for memory control. Chunking must not alter draw generation, reduction order, outputs, or hashes.

implementation_determinism_v10.provenance: Record representation version PH22B_BOOTSTRAP_SUFFICIENT_STATS_V1; ordered block-input/A/b/n hashes; little-endian int64 draw and multiplicity hashes; solver/library/environment versions; every little-endian float64 replicate-vector hash; equivalence fixture hashes; benchmark wall time and peak memory; deterministic replay hashes.
failure_conditions: rank deficiency or condition ceiling breach

implementation_determinism_v11.precedence: Supersedes only implementation_determinism_v10.equivalence_contract.numeric_acceptance and adds the deterministic fallback below. Every v10 bootstrap population, draw, seed, replicate count, statistic, solver primary path, covariance, threshold, decision, performance gate, authority, and scientific definition remains unchanged.
implementation_determinism_v11.reason: A fixed componentwise ULP limit is invalid for comparing DGELSD with a normal-equation SPD solve because forward error scales with condition number and near-zero components can have arbitrarily large ULP distance. No market outcomes were inspected.

condition_aware_equivalence.constants: eps=np.finfo(np.float64).eps. Let kappa_X be the expanded-reference weighted-design 2-norm condition number from DGELSD singular values. Let kappa_A=kappa_X^2.
condition_aware_equivalence.beta_bound: delta_beta=||beta_compressed-beta_reference||_2/max(||beta_reference||_2,np.finfo(float64).tiny). Require delta_beta <= tau_beta, tau_beta=256*eps*max(1,kappa_A)/(1-256*eps*max(1,kappa_A)). If the denominator is <=0 or tau_beta>1e-3, use the deterministic factorized fallback.
condition_aware_equivalence.backward_error: rho=||A*beta-b||_inf/(||A||_inf*||beta||_inf+||b||_inf), with 0/0 defined as 0. Require finite rho <=256*eps*K for either compressed solver.
condition_aware_equivalence.covariance_bound: delta_cov=||Cov_compressed-Cov_reference||_F/max(||Cov_reference||_F,tiny). Require delta_cov <= tau_cov, tau_cov=4096*eps*max(1,kappa_A^2). If tau_cov>1e-2, use the deterministic factorized fallback; after fallback the same tau_cov bound applies with cap 1e-2.
condition_aware_equivalence.scalar_bound: For each coefficient-derived scalar t, require abs(t_compressed-t_reference) <= tau_t*max(1,abs(t_reference)), tau_t=min(1e-2,8192*eps*max(1,kappa_A^2)). P-values additionally require absolute difference <=max(tau_t,8*eps).
condition_aware_equivalence.exact_requirements: Draw indices, day multiplicities, logical N/G, ranks, rank/condition pass-fail, missingness, finite/failure states, p-value numerator counts, percentile index selection, FDR membership, and all Boolean scientific decisions must be identical.
condition_aware_equivalence.boundary_fail_close: For every scientific numeric boundary c, compute margin=min(abs(t_reference-c),abs(t_compressed-c)). If margin <= max(the applicable absolute error bound,8*eps*max(1,abs(c))), mark PHASE_22B_INVALID_RESEARCH_RUN rather than choosing a side. This tolerance never changes a threshold.

factorized_fallback.trigger: Use fallback deterministically when a condition-aware primary-path bound requires it, the SPD solve fails, or any primary-path equivalence fixture fails. Triggering is based only on matrices/numerical diagnostics, never outcomes favorability or scientific result.
factorized_fallback.day_factorization: For each UTC-day block compute deterministic reduced QR of sqrt(W_g)*X_g using scipy.linalg.qr(mode="economic",pivoting=False,check_finite=True) in frozen row/column order, and d_g=Q_g^T*(sqrt(W_g)*y_g). Canonicalize each R_g diagonal nonnegative by multiplying the corresponding R row and d element by -1 when its diagonal is negative.
factorized_fallback.replicate_matrix: For each source day with multiplicity m_bg>0 append sqrt(float64(m_bg))*R_g and sqrt(float64(m_bg))*d_g once, days in frozen order. This factorized least-squares objective is mathematically identical to m_bg logical copies. Run numpy.linalg.lstsq on the stacked factor matrix/vector with frozen RCOND and DGELSD path.
factorized_fallback.covariance: Use the unchanged v10 A_g/b_g logical N/G and m*s*s CR1 construction with the fallback beta. Do not derive CR1 from QR pseudo-clusters.
factorized_fallback.failure: Fail closed for fallback rank/condition mismatch, nonfinite values, equivalence-bound failure, boundary ambiguity, or performance-gate failure. No third solver is allowed.

fixture_and_replay.fixtures: Fixed no-data fixtures include benign Gaussian K=20/N=5000 and K=80/N=20000 cases, near-rank full-rank cases across condition decades, repeated-day draws, covariance/Wald/attenuation/linear contrasts, and near-zero coefficients. Both primary and fallback paths must be exercised.
fixture_and_replay.replay: Expanded-reference comparisons are mandatory fixture validation, not production replay. Production compressed execution must be byte-identical to its own second run, including solver-path vector, numerical-diagnostic vector, replicate vector, hashes, decisions, and canonical bytes.
fixture_and_replay.performance: The existing v10 30-minute/4-GiB benchmark and <=12-hour full-workload extrapolation include deterministic fallback costs at the observed fixture trigger rate. If projected fallback frequency cannot meet the bound, data access remains blocked.

implementation_determinism_v12.precedence: Supersedes only production-use reference dependencies, fallback bread, post-fallback bounds, derived-statistic error propagation, and fallback performance-frequency language in implementation_determinism_v11. Fixture comparisons remain validation-only. All scientific/bootstrap semantics remain unchanged.

production_condition_and_solver.primary_condition: For each replicate derive lambda_min/lambda_max from the already-frozen eigvalsh(A_b). Set kappa_A=lambda_max/lambda_min and kappa_X=sqrt(kappa_A). These production values require no expanded reference.
production_condition_and_solver.primary_envelope: eps=float64 epsilon; eta_beta=256*eps*kappa_A. Primary SPD is admissible only when eta_beta<0.5, Cholesky/solve succeeds, and the frozen backward-error check passes. Its production coefficient-vector radius is E_beta=[eta_beta/(1-eta_beta)]*max(||beta||_2,tiny).
production_condition_and_solver.fallback_preflight: Before computing any bootstrap scientific statistic, generate and hash all exact schedules; build every A_b; run eigvalsh and a no-output Cholesky eligibility check; deterministically mark primary/fallback/invalid from matrix-only diagnostics. No y, coefficient sign, p-value, threshold, or outcome favorability may select the path.
production_condition_and_solver.fallback_condition: For fallback, compute singular values s of the stacked day-factor matrix F using numpy.linalg.svd(F,compute_uv=False,full_matrices=False). Set kappa_X=s_max/s_min; apply frozen RCOND/rank and condition ceiling. eta_beta=256*eps*kappa_X; require eta_beta<0.5 and the factor-system backward-error check.
production_condition_and_solver.fallback_beta_envelope: E_beta=[eta_beta/(1-eta_beta)]*max(||beta||_2,tiny), using the production fallback beta and kappa_X. A nonfinite bound or eta_beta>=0.5 is operational invalidity, not a third solver.

fallback_bread_and_covariance.factor_svd: For a fallback replicate compute U,s,Vt=numpy.linalg.svd(F,full_matrices=False) in frozen factor-row/column order. Require exactly K retained singular values under frozen RCOND and condition ceiling.
fallback_bread_and_covariance.bread: Bread=Vt.T @ diag(1/s^2) @ Vt, computed float64 in displayed order and symmetrized once. This is (F^T F)^-1 without invoking the failed SPD solve.
fallback_bread_and_covariance.meat: Use unchanged v10 source-day A_g/b_g scores, multiplicities, logical N/G, and sum m*s*s^T. QR factor rows are never clusters.
fallback_bread_and_covariance.covariance_envelope: For primary set eta_cov=4096*eps*kappa_A^2; for fallback set eta_cov=8192*eps*kappa_X^2. Require eta_cov<0.5. Production Frobenius radius E_cov=[eta_cov/(1-eta_cov)]*max(||Cov||_F,tiny). Nonfinite or failed bounds invalidate.

derived_statistic_intervals.linear_contrast: For frozen contrast vector a use center=a^T beta and radius ||a||_2*E_beta.
derived_statistic_intervals.attenuation: For 1-beta_B/beta_A, form numerator coefficient intervals from their E_beta values. If the beta_A interval contains zero, invalidate. Otherwise use outward-rounded interval arithmetic over all four endpoint quotients and transform by 1-q; point remains the compressed center formula.
derived_statistic_intervals.direct_pair_day: For sufficient-statistic sums use gamma_q=(q*eps)/(1-q*eps), q=2*number_of_nonzero_day_terms in the ordered reduction, requiring q*eps<0.5. Sum radius is gamma_q*sum(abs(terms)). Propagate mean, difference, year mean, absolute value, and ratio by outward-rounded interval arithmetic; a denominator interval containing zero invalidates.
derived_statistic_intervals.bootstrap_quantiles: For each replicate retain [L_b,U_b]. For each frozen percentile, stable-sort all L_b and separately all U_b and apply numpy.quantile(method="linear") at the frozen probability. The reported point uses point replicates; its certified interval is [quantile(L),quantile(U)].
derived_statistic_intervals.p_values: For a sign/count p-value, every replicate interval must lie wholly on one side of, or touch exactly, the frozen null boundary. If an interval straddles the boundary, invalidate. Exact boundary equality follows the frozen inclusive/exclusive count rule. The numerator and p-value are then exact under the certified intervals.
derived_statistic_intervals.decision_boundary: For every effect, attenuation, CI endpoint, ratio, concentration, stability, p-value, and classification boundary c, decide only when the certified interval is wholly on one required side. If it contains or touches c where equality treatment cannot resolve the frozen predicate, invalidate. Never move c or select a favorable side.
derived_statistic_intervals.wald_note: Bootstrap replicates do not create new omnibus Wald decisions. Point-model Wald tests retain their frozen DGELSD/CR1 implementation. If a future authorized stage applies a covariance-derived bootstrap scalar, its exact analytic interval-propagation formula must be frozen before access.

fixture_separation.fixture_only: Expanded DGELSD beta_reference, Cov_reference, t_reference, and its kappa_X are used only in no-data equivalence fixtures. They are forbidden dependencies in production path selection, envelopes, thresholds, or replay.
fixture_separation.fixture_acceptance: Fixtures verify compressed centers fall inside both the production-computable certified interval and the condition-aware reference error bound, with identical schedules/ranks/failures/decisions. Fixture failure blocks implementation.
fixture_separation.production_replay: Replay compares the compressed production run only and requires byte-identical solver-path vector, envelopes, intervals, statistics, decisions, and hashes.

bounded_fallback_performance.maximum: At most 100 of 10000 replicates per exact model/response population may use factorized fallback (1%). The matrix-only preflight counts this before any bootstrap scientific statistic is emitted. Count>100 invalidates the run.
bounded_fallback_performance.benchmark: The v10 primary benchmark remains. Additionally benchmark exactly 100 worst-case K=80,1096-day fallback fits plus 9900 primary fits under frozen single-thread settings; combined wall time must be <=30 minutes and peak additional memory <=4 GiB.
bounded_fallback_performance.full_workload: Extrapolate using the exact frozen list of model/response populations, 100 fallbacks per population, and measured primary/fallback times. Require total <=12 hours before market-data access. No fixture-observed fallback frequency is used.

implementation_determinism_v12.provenance: Record production kappa/envelope/path vectors, fallback count per population, factor/input hashes, interval endpoint hashes, preflight hash, benchmark evidence, and byte-identical replay evidence.
failure_conditions: production rule references expanded fixture result
